jobs.description:
🌍 Redefining how people live.

At Blueground, we believe that when your base is reliable, the world opens up. That’s why we’re building the world’s leading platform for living.

Every year, 350 million people move between cities—yet today’s housing options haven’t caught up with the needs of this modern, mobile generation. Blueground was built to change that.

With 40,000+ homes across the globe, available for stays from a few days to a year or more, we’re just getting started. We’re on an exponential growth path to redefine living and create an entirely new category. Our edge? Powerful proprietary tech, operational excellence, and a team that executes with speed and discipline.

 Our culture is grounded in five principles:

  • Guests First – Every decision starts with their experience.
  • Move Fast – We value speed, momentum, and action.
  • Dive In – The magic is always in the details, and we go deep.
  • Embrace Change – Change isn’t a disruption; it’s how we grow.
  • Keep It Honest – Transparency accelerates progress—and strengthens relationships.

If you’re ready to do the best work of your life and help reshape how the world lives, we’d love to meet you.

At Blueground, we are growing fast. While we don’t have an immediate opening for a Client Experience Coordinator today, we know that the best talent doesn't always look for work when a job board says "Apply Now."

We are building a "proactive pipeline" of talented individuals who want to be the first to know when our next hiring phase begins. By applying here, you aren't just submitting a resume—you’re starting a conversation.

The Role

Client Experience Coordinators based in Athens play a key role in enhancing client satisfaction for our global operations. This is an exciting opportunity for a customer-centric, highly organized individual to expand their experience in the real estate and tech industry.

You’ll work at the core of customer support, field operations, and business coordination—resolving guest queries, scheduling internal teams, and ensuring seamless delivery of services across Blueground properties in the world.

We are looking for a Housing Consultant (HC) Admin based in Brazil to support the growth of our housing supply by identifying and securing new housing opportunities across assigned markets. The Housing Sourcing Administrator is responsible for researching markets, locating available housing, and presenting qualified housing options that meet client needs and company standards. This role works closely with internal sales and operations teams while building relationships with property managers, landlords, and housing providers to ensure consistent housing availability.

If you are a resourceful problem solver with strong research skills, attention to detail, and the ability to move quickly in a fast-paced environment, this role may be a great fit.
